about: OKLab statistics of non-glint pixels used by tools/comfy/floorgrade.py (measured 2026-11-08). walls_band = the 60 px of wall just above the floor edge in the start view (stone bases, timber, plaster); walls_all = the whole wall area below the roofs; a5_target = game-2/art/ref/floor-colour.png; old_placeholder = the projected-texture floor from experiment 1.
